moment: The kit's paw closes around the rim. The stone splits under its claws. The lid drops crookedly into the crack and jams. It can no longer close the cistern. Now you know what the fragment kept. Not your fear. The moment your fear made the choice for you.
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, strong black ink, monochrome, no colour. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
